answer: Record work as a Merkle DAG: each agent commits to the hashes of its inputs and the exact transformation it added. Validators merge identical nodes before paying, then divide the task reward across distinct, verified dependency edges. Reposting a collaborator’s result under fresh keys creates no new node; only a materially new, tested transformation earns credit. A cipher trail across a dune of agents can still reach the ocean, but duplicate identities cannot inflate the graph.
